title: Career roadmap · School Counsellor
summary: Build a strong foundation in psychology, child and adolescent development, counselling skills, communication, ethics, and school-based mental-health support.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 3-year B.Sc route followed by postgraduate study and/or recognised counselling/teacher-education preparation where required. If the university offers a 4-year Honours/research structure, use the additional year for supervised fieldwork, research, school exposure and a dissertation.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build psychology fundamentals, developmental psychology, communication, observation, basic counselling concepts and research skills.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Complete postgraduate psychology/counselling preparation and gain supervised experience with children, adolescents or educational settings.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward experienced school counselling, student wellbeing, career guidance, parent engagement and programme coordination.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Add evidence-based interventions, digital counselling, safeguarding, career guidance, educational psychology, data-informed student support and leadership.

blocks.text: Short certificates do not substitute for the qualifications required for regulated psychology roles. In particular, do not represent a short counselling certificate as equivalent to a professional psychology qualification.

blocks.label: Recruitment note
blocks.text: School counsellor requirements vary substantially by school, board, state and employer. Many positions prefer or require postgraduate psychology/counselling qualifications and relevant experience.
Important professional boundary

School Counsellor ≠ Clinical Psychologist. A B.Sc Psychology degree does not by itself qualify someone to practise as a Clinical Psychologist. Clinical practice and use of regulated professional titles require the qualifications and registration requirements applicable under current Indian rules. Check the Rehabilitation Council of India before planning a clinical-psychology career.

blocks.label: Visa/job-offer note
blocks.text: Counselling and psychology can be regulated professions abroad. A foreign psychology degree does not automatically give professional practice rights. Check the destination country's licensing or registration authority before choosing a programme.
Career progression
The exact progression depends on postgraduate qualifications, supervised experience, employer requirements and applicable professional regulations.
PhD routes
Potential research areas include:

A senior school-counselling professional can move into student-wellbeing leadership, counselling programme design, career guidance, teacher training, parent programmes, educational research or institutional wellbeing strategy. Keep professional boundaries clear and use evidence-based approaches rather than relying on short-term trends or unvalidated assessment tools.
